images.texture_rot90: numpy.rot90(texture); keypoint (x, y) maps to (y, W - 1 - x), W = 320

params.rotation_points: the texture 'interior' keypoints (quarter-pixel grid, 75 px from every border); scene_rot90 is a plain case
params.scene_rot90: numpy.rot90(scene), counter-clockwise, 480 x 640; keypoint (x, y) maps to (y, W - 1 - x), W = 640
